preheader: Amazon slides on weak guidance, Intel falls 25%, and McKinsey charts enterprise AI.

lead.headline: Amazon Slides as Slower Holiday Outlook Overshadows Cloud Gains
lead.body: Amazon shares dropped as much as 7% in after-hours trading after the company reported a quarterly revenue miss and issued a cautious forecast for the holiday quarter. The pullback came despite strong performance at Amazon Web Services, where CEO Andy Jassy is targeting long-term growth. The sharp reaction reflects a broader trend on Wall Street of heavily penalizing earnings misses as investors worry corporate profit growth is peaking.
lead.why: When you study corporate valuation at Merage, keep in mind that even high-performing cloud divisions cannot always shield a stock if retail guidance falls short.

stories.headline: Intel Crashes 25% on PC Correction and AI Infrastructure Jitters
stories.body: Intel plunged 25% after reporting a severe correction in the personal computer market that caught investors off guard. The steep drop dragged down premarket trading across AI infrastructure and chip suppliers.
stories.why: This is a clean reminder for tech investing that cyclical hardware demand still drives the core business while new chips ramp up.

stories.headline: Shell Earnings Double to $10.8 Billion on Soaring Oil Prices
stories.body: Shell reported third-quarter underlying earnings of $10.81 billion, nearly doubling its profit from the prior quarter. The company benefited from higher global crude prices linked to conflict involving Iran.
stories.why: Tracking commodity price shocks helps your macro forecasting, since rising fuel costs feed directly into corporate margins across consumer industries.

stories.headline: Nvidia in Talks to Back $30 Billion Anthropic Data Center
stories.body: Nvidia is discussing credit guarantees to help finance a $30 billion data center project in West Virginia being developed by UK-based Nscale for Anthropic. The arrangement would help secure debt financing for the massive computing facility.
stories.why: If you look into tech investment banking, note how hardware vendors use credit support to finance their largest customers' infrastructure.

stories.headline: Oracle Defends $165 Billion Project Jupiter Buildout
stories.body: Oracle dismissed market concerns over Project Jupiter, its $165 billion AI data center initiative in New Mexico. Leadership insisted they are comfortable with the capital commitments required to build the massive complex.
stories.why: Keep an eye on capital expenditure line items when evaluating cloud platforms, because massive data center commitments require sustained customer demand to pay off.

stories.headline: McKinsey Finds 92% of Firms Raising AI Spend, but Only 1% Are Mature
stories.body: A McKinsey report found that 92% of companies plan to boost AI investment over the next three years. However, only 1% of corporate leaders consider their organizations mature in deploying the technology across everyday operations.
stories.why: In consulting interviews, emphasizing the gap between buying software and organizational change management shows you understand real corporate execution.

stories.headline: TPG and Bain Capital Compete for Indian Retailer Baazar Retail
stories.body: Global private equity firms TPG Capital, Bain Capital, and CVC Capital are in the running to acquire a majority stake in value retail chain Baazar Retail. Investment bank o3 Capital is managing the sale process.
stories.why: Following competitive buyout bids gives you a clear look at how private equity firms source deals and price regional retail platforms.

stories.headline: Djokovic Upset by Struff in Basel Indoors Thriller
stories.body: Jan-Lennard Struff defeated 39-year-old Novak Djokovic in a two-hour and 35-minute match at the Swiss Indoors in Basel. The loss deprives Djokovic of valuable points in his bid to qualify for the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin.

term.name: Credit Guarantee
term.definition: A formal commitment by a third party to cover a borrower's debt obligations if that borrower fails to make payments. In tech infrastructure, Nvidia is discussing credit guarantees to help data center operator Nscale finance a $30 billion project for Anthropic. These guarantees reassure institutional lenders and lower interest costs on massive capital projects.

serve.headline: Serval raised $150M to take on ServiceNow
serve.body: Enterprise automation startup Serval raised $150 million in a round led by Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $3 billion. Serval builds AI-driven workflow software aimed directly at replacing legacy IT platforms like ServiceNow.
